text:
sam: Tiny PSA: I'm starting a 'prompt petting zoo' thread. bring your weirdest model personas. low stakes, high giggles. :sheep:
ivy: love it. introducing 'mrs. verbose' — answers in 10-sentence parables even for yes/no q's.
brad: i have "sir trims-a-lot" who insists on pruning every long prompt down to 3 lines and then apologizes. :scissors:
design: can we get icons? i want a tiny top hat for sir trims-a-lot.
ops-bot: poll created: "Which persona wins 'Most Likely to Over-Explain'?" Options: mrs. verbose, sir trims-a-lot, the clarifying gremlin
sam: voted mrs. verbose (and guilty). once asked it to summarize a paragraph and i got a novella.
ivy: also have 'clarifying gremlin' who follows up with exactly three follow-ups in increasingly suspicious tones.
brad: sample convo (safe demo):
sam: "clarifying gremlin, summarize this email"
clarifying gremlin: "Quick Q1: did they mean the Q3 budget? Q2: is the timeline firm? Q3: want bullets or TL;DR?"
ivy: that gremlin energy is me in meetings.
design: sticker idea: tiny gremlin with a magnifying glass and a caption "Did you mean?"
ops-bot: poll closed. Results: mrs. verbose 48%, clarifying gremlin 33%, sir trims-a-lot 19%.
brad: btw who else writes tiny bios for their dev models and pins them to the repo README? guilty.
sam: i have a README section titled "Model Mascots" with a 2-line quip each. apparently it's comforting.
ivy: new tradition idea: 'Adopt-a-Persona' every sprint. adopt, name, and give a tiny backstory. winner gets a merch sticker.
design: i'll mock sticker sheets: hats, mugs, tiny magnifiers. will post sketches in #design-memes.
brad: unironic merch request: a mug that says "I prune prompts". will buy 3.
sam: rules: no real people names, keep it SFW, don't store customer text in bios.
ivy: also optional: mood tag. e.g., mrs. verbose [philosophical], clarifying gremlin [suspicious], sir trims-a-lot [efficient].
ops-bot: reminder: do not add secrets to README or public stickers.
design: posting art in 24h. who wants to test-print one sticker? i'll send to volunteers.
sam: i'm in. promise to only plaster it on my laptop and not on infra racks.
brad: ditto. also planning to write a tiny 'persona adoption' form: name, fav snack, debugging chant. fun content for onboarding.
ivy: love the chant idea. clarifying gremlin chant: "Did you mean? Please specify."
sam: closing thought: if this gets too real we blame the coffee. :coffee:
